caption: A frozen block of soup sits in a pan over heat, sliding around on a thin layer of melt and shrinking as the liquid pools around it.

sa.check: A frozen block of soup sits in a pan on a hob.
The block slides on a thin layer of melt.
A pool of liquid grows around it.
The block loosens from the pan's floor.
The melting comes first and the sliding follows.

pc.expect: The block only shrinks while the pool grows, and the pool does not freeze again on the hot pan.
pc.fail: The block grows; or the pool draws back into the block; or the pool freezes solid around the block on the hot pan; or the block alternates between larger and smaller.

pc.expect: The block glides only as the pan is tilted or moved and as it rides on the melt, and it slows and stops when the pan is still.
pc.fail: The block darts across a level pan with nothing touching it; or spins fast on the spot; or climbs the pan's wall and hangs there; or slides uphill in a tilted pan.

pc.expect: The block settles downward as it melts and the pool spreads outward and downhill across the pan.
pc.fail: The block lifts off the pan and hangs; or the pool climbs the pan's wall and stays; or the pool gathers uphill of the block in a tilted pan; or melted soup lifts off the pan.

pc.expect: The block melts where it touches the hot pan: its underside wets first and the pool spreads from beneath it.
pc.fail: The block melts from its top while its underside stays frosted and dry; or a pool spreads on a part of the pan the block never touched; or the block slides about on a dry pan with no melt under it.

pc.expect: One block in one pan; the soup goes only from the block into the pool.
pc.fail: The block vanishes while still large; or a second block appears; or the pool's level jumps with nothing added; or soup passes through the pan's wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pan, the hob and the soup's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or the soup changes colour; or items around the hob rearrange.
